fusions.name: Ramming Brow
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target and rams it head-first, which deals 14 damage and leaves it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Slams down broadside, which deals 30 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Barnacle Crust
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Fathom Plate
fusions.desc: Conjures plate built for the deep: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 12, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
